import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MX = 5500;
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;
    static int n, m, k, c, d;
    static int s = MX - 2, t = MX - 1;
    static int mf = 0;
    static int[] tr = new int[MX];
    static long ans = 0;
    static long[] dis = new long[MX];
    static List<Edge>[] adj = new List[MX];
    static PriorityQueue<Pair> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();

    static class Edge {
        int to, cost, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int cost, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long dist;
        int vertex;
        Pair(long dist, int vertex) {
            this.dist = dist;
            this.vertex = vertex;
        }
        public int compareTo(Pair other) {
            return Long.compare(this.dist, other.dist);
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c, int cap) {
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, c, adj[v].size(), cap));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, -c, adj[u].size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static void dijkstra() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        pq.clear();
        pq.add(new Pair(0, s));
        dis[s] = 0;
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = pq.poll();
            int u = p.vertex;
            if (p.dist != dis[u]) continue;
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && dis[e.to] > dis[u] + e.cost) {
                    dis[e.to] = dis[u] + e.cost;
                    tr[e.to] = e.rev;
                    pq.add(new Pair(dis[e.to], e.to));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void trace() {
        int flow = k;
        int v = t;
        while (v != s) {
            Edge e = adj[v].get(tr[v]);
            int u = e.to;
            int ind = e.rev;
            flow = Math.min(flow, adj[u].get(ind).cap);
            v = u;
        }
        mf += flow;
        ans += flow * dis[t];
        v = t;
        while (v != s) {
            Edge e = adj[v].get(tr[v]);
            int u = e.to;
            int ind = e.rev;
            adj[v].get(tr[v]).cap += flow;
            adj[u].get(ind).cap -= flow;
            v = u;
        }
    }

    static int at(int u, int t) {
        return u + t * n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < MX; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        int mx = n + k;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            add_edge(s, at(u, 0), 0, 1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= mx; i++) {
            add_edge(at(1, i), t, c * i, k);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < mx; j++) {
                add_edge(at(i, j), at(i, j + 1), 0, k);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int people = 1; people <= k; people++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < mx; j++) {
                    int cost = d * (2 * people - 1);
                    add_edge(at(u, j), at(v, j + 1), cost, 1);
                    add_edge(at(v, j), at(u, j + 1), cost, 1);
                }
            }
        }

        while (mf < k) {
            dijkstra();
            trace();
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
